supersedes.reason: The v6 handoff predates the committed recovery prefix and does not describe the P2-05C cleanup-receipt dependency.

current_source_binding.scope: Only the current mode, cleanup, lifecycle-registry, deterministic-gate, controller-only taskpack, and focused-test seams required by P2-06R and P2-07B-R.
exclusions: This handoff is implementation guidance, not Phase 2 benchmark or promotion evidence.
It does not authorize P2-08, candidate-release installation, live provider calibration, source merge, or push.
It does not replace protocol, run-manifest, runtime-release, controller, sandbox, invocation-set, sealed-result, cleanup-receipt, or gate-epoch authority.

repo_map_handoff.implementation_state: The three adapters, common lifecycle registry, common evaluator/finalizer, deterministic gate registry, relation validators, and controller-only taskpack path exist in the bound source. P2-05C production cleanup is not connected: cleanup_clean_snapshot is a tested helper, but ExperimentCommonFinalizer does not call it, no cleanup-receipt schema exists, and projection/rendering still observe the sealed bundle's immutable pending value.

sequence: execute_bound_experiment_mode validates the immutable allocation and clean snapshot, then acquires the run controller lease.
ExperimentModeController.execute accepts only the concrete adapter declared by the run manifest.
Every provider lifecycle is registered through _register_provider_launch or TwoPhaseFileScheduler._register_experiment_attempt_launch.
publish_registered_model_invocation_set_reference seals the complete registry before ExperimentCommonFinalizer evaluates and seals the terminal result.
Both successful and recoverable adapter-failure paths converge on ExperimentCommonFinalizer.
ExperimentCommonFinalizer seals, reloads, and validates results/terminal.
P2-05C must then remove only run_dir/repository, publish an immutable cleanup receipt outside that snapshot, and reload the sealed result to prove its digest is unchanged.
Projection, show, and comparison must derive effective cleanup status from the receipt; the immutable bundle remains pending.
P2-06R must make every normal, failure, and replayed mode outcome return through this same receipt-aware finalization contract.
taskpack validation permits an empty backlog only for a candidate-release-bound controller_only taskpack with the fixed P2-08, P2-09, P2-10 graph.
_run_controller_only_taskpack seals or reloads the gate epoch and invokes _run_available_phase2_gate_controllers without starting a worker pool.
run_gate_controller recomputes the registered relation; P2-09 returns awaiting_operator_authorization with zero provider calls until current authorization validates.
_evaluate_post_backlog_gates requires current epoch-scoped receipts and controller results before milestone completion.

verified_current_gaps.evidence: experiment_modes._build_common_result_bundle passes cleanup_status="pending" and projection_db._scan_experiment_results reads only the sealed bundle.
execute_bound_experiment_mode allocates run_dir/repository before ExperimentModeController.execute can return _replayed_mode_result, so a cleaned terminal replay can recreate the disposable snapshot.

entry_and_common_finalization.contract: Keep one concrete-adapter dispatch and one common evaluator/finalizer. Insert receipt-aware cleanup only after the terminal bundle has been sealed, reloaded, and validated. Adapter failures that can be finalized must use the same ordering.

three_mode_adapters.invariant: One fresh registered Codex lifecycle receives no AgentTeam task context and uses the protocol model and reasoning profile.
Validate the preregistered frozen taskpack digest before applying the controller-trusted standalone snapshot root.
Author and freeze in an independent standalone repository, reject the preregistered direct-taskpack digest, and pass no direct-taskpack input to authoring.

runtime_context_and_lifecycle_registry.purpose: Build equal protocol/model/controller context and allocate single/author lifecycle and sandbox authority.
Own append-only lifecycle registration, workspace-specific sandbox binding, complete registry sealing, and manifest reload.
Reload immutable launch registration, enforce sandbox and one-lane admission before provider execution, and publish terminal lifecycle authority.
Allocate and reconcile every worker-attempt workspace, sandbox, and lifecycle before dispatch.
Preserve experiment and lifecycle authority through mailbox projection.
Keep repo-map, worker, review, and other AgentTeam provider calls on ModelInvocationCall.
Retain one protocol-global provider lane, terminal-only accounting, safe boundaries, and original-budget resume.

current_cleanup_helper.current_behavior: cleanup_clean_snapshot accepts only a sealed result inside the run and outside run_dir/repository, fsyncs and hashes it, removes only the attested snapshot, reports removed, already_absent, or failed, and rehashes the result. Its return value is transient and not yet durable authority.

sealed_result_authority.invariant: Do not mutate the sealed bundle to update cleanup_status. Bind the receipt to experiment_run_id and the sealed bundle/result digest, then revalidate that result after cleanup.

required_bindings: sealed result path and sealed bundle/result digest
cleanup status and bounded failure evidence
receipt_schema.publication_rule: Publish create-if-absent and atomically only after the result has been sealed and validated and cleanup has completed or failed; conflicting replay must fail closed.

projection_consumers.contract: Derive effective cleanup status from a valid receipt. Missing receipt means incomplete/pending; failed receipt remains failed; DB and file fallback must agree and the receipt must never make SQLite authoritative.

p2_06r_consumer_contract: All three adapters and recoverable adapter failures must return only after the common finalizer has produced a valid cleanup receipt or a durable failed receipt.
The returned sealed_result summary should carry receipt-derived cleanup state/reference without rewriting result.json.

A terminal replay must load and validate the sealed result and cleanup receipt before deciding whether a snapshot is needed; it must not recreate a snapshot that a valid removed or already_absent receipt proves disposable.
Lifecycle registry sealing and common evaluation must finish before cleanup so evaluation never loses its candidate workspace.

integration_risks.impact: The evaluator or result binder loses the candidate repository.
integration_risks.guard: Keep cleanup after seal_experiment_result_bundle, load_experiment_result_bundle, and _validate_sealed_mode_result.

integration_risks.impact: Immutable terminal authority and bundle_sha256 become invalid.
integration_risks.guard: Publish a separate receipt and derive effective status outside result.json.

integration_risks.impact: A completed run regains disposable state inconsistent with its receipt.
integration_risks.guard: Move or add sealed-result/receipt replay detection before execute_bound_experiment_mode allocates run_dir/repository.

integration_risks.impact: Modes or infrastructure-failure outcomes expose unequal lifecycle evidence.
integration_risks.guard: Keep cleanup in ExperimentCommonFinalizer and the shared replay path, never inside an adapter.

integration_risks.impact: Author, worker-attempt, follow-up, or late invocations escape evaluation.
integration_risks.guard: Preserve complete registration equality and terminal checks in publish_registered_model_invocation_set_reference.

integration_risks.impact: Modes share objects, refs, or prior-run state.
integration_risks.guard: Preserve allocate_clean_snapshot and create_independent_attempt_workspace standalone object-store checks.

invariants: Only the fixed P2-08, P2-09, P2-10 graph and registered controller/validator/schema tuples are executable.
Each relation validator reloads artifacts and recomputes Git, digest, result, authorization, and evidence relations.
P2-09 authorization is checked before provider_launcher; absent authorization returns awaiting_operator_authorization with provider_calls=0 and target_mutations=0.
P2-10 accepts historical P2-09 authorization only through the exact single-child report/roadmap relation defined by the plan.

calibration_relation_dependencies.invariant: Gate validation reloads sealed results and invocation authority, proves exactly three primary modes plus one repeat, equal inputs, unique results, and complete usage.

epoch_and_controller_orchestration.invariant: Receipts and controller results are epoch-scoped, deterministic progression pauses at P2-09, and controller_only execution starts no worker pool.

controller_only_taskpack_guard.invariant: Zero tasks/agents are valid only for blueprint-materialized controller_only authority with non-empty fixed gates, committed schemas and action authority, and candidate-release binding.

integration_risks.impact: A syntactically valid claim can pass without Git/evidence truth.
integration_risks.guard: Keep validate_gate_relation as the mandatory path and retain all three dedicated relation validators.

integration_risks.impact: P2-09 makes an unauthorized live call.
integration_risks.guard: Keep require_live_provider_authorization before provider_launcher and test zero allocation/calls when absent.

integration_risks.impact: Authorization or receipts from an earlier baseline authorize the current gate.
integration_risks.guard: Recompute _phase2_gate_relation_context from the current sealed epoch and enforce the explicit historical-authorization exception only for P2-10.

integration_risks.impact: An empty backlog can start model workers or falsely complete.
The implementation run executes newly written P2-08 code or changes external release/source state.
integration_risks.guard: This recovery task may validate only; do not install a release, execute P2-08, merge, or push.

add_or_extend: A common-finalizer test proving seal and validation precede cleanup and immutable receipt publication.
A fault-injection test proving failed cleanup preserves the sealed bundle and projects/renders failed from the receipt.
An idempotent replay test proving a valid removed or already_absent receipt does not recreate run_dir/repository.
A missing/conflicting receipt test proving cleanup remains incomplete or fails closed rather than becoming completed.
Exercise all three adapters and a recoverable infrastructure failure through the common P2-05C receipt path with no live provider.
Reject missing, stale, extra, unconsumed, and non-terminal lifecycle registrations before evaluation.
Prove author, attempt, and candidate repositories have distinct in-workspace Git object stores and no linked-worktree control files.
Keep all provider launchers fake and assert the recovery run never executes P2-08.
Prove stale epoch receipts/authorization are rejected and deterministic resume continues from the first unresolved gate.
Prove the controller-only path starts no worker pool and cannot use experiment mode runtime context.
